verified_facts.text: A private art collection of more than 3,000 pieces lines the staircase and public spaces.
verified_facts.excerpt: A 3,000-plus-piece private collection distracts and bedazzles, lining the famed staircase and every other space besides.

verified_facts.text: A water installation by Tadao Ando stands outside the front door.
